---
title: "Phylogenetic placement of *Mimosa pabstiana* reinforces a biogeographic pattern of the Pleistocene Arc Theory in *Mimosa* (Leguminosae, Caesalpinoideae)"
date: "2024-06-25"
categories: [phylogeny, biogeography, mimosa, leguminosae]

![](image.jpg){width=50% fig-align="center"}

This study investigates the phylogenetic placement of *Mimosa pabstiana* and its implications for the biogeographic patterns of the Pleistocene Arc Theory in the genus *Mimosa* (Leguminosae, Caesalpinoideae). The authors used molecular data to analyze the evolutionary relationships of *M. pabstiana* and to explore its biogeographic history.

[https://doi.org/10.11646/phytotaxa.655.2.6](https://doi.org/10.11646/phytotaxa.655.2.6)
